reviews.review_title: Demo needs optimization, but an excellen
reviews.review_description:
At the moment, the demo still has some optimization issues, but it’s important to keep in mind that it is only a demo. The effort adjustment system for running is excellent.

The developer’s idea is to create an overlay app that could work with any VR game that uses the joystick! And this idea is absolutely amazing!

So I’m giving it five stars, not so much because of the quality of the demo itself, but because the idea is absolutely outstanding. I really hope they take it all the way to completion!!
